title: The Demon-Possessed Man in the Country of the Gerasenes
description: Jesus delivers a demon-possessed man in the country of the Gerasenes. The evil spirits, calling themselves Legion because they are many, ask to be sent into a herd of pigs. Jesus allows them, and the herd rushes down a steep bank into the sea and drowns. The healed man is sent home to tell what the Lord has done for him.
